heroTitle: Turn an idea into a song worth remembering.
heroBody: Describe what you want to hear, choose a style, then get two versions of your song.
stepOneBody: Describe the moment, feeling, or message you want the song to carry.
stepTwoBody: Pick a genre, language, and voice that fit your idea.
stepThreeBody: Compare the results, download, and share your song.
sampleBody: Two versions for every request, ready to listen to and download.
faqOneQ: What do I get after creating a song?
faqOneA: You get two versions of one song. Listen to them and download the MP3 files.
faqTwoQ: Can I use my own lyrics?
faqTwoA: Yes. Paste your own lyrics, or use the free lyrics helper.
footerNote: Made for Tanzania's songwriters and creators.
